entry.title: [要確認] npm: joi: quadratic-time split in `string().email({ multiple: true })` allows denial of service (HIGH)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要確認 joiのemail(multiple)で二乗時間のDoS。HIGH
→ joi 17.13.9/18.3.1に更新

joi >= 17.1.1, < 17.13.9 → 17.13.9, @hapi/joi >= 16.0.0, <= 17.1.1, joi >= 18.0.0, < 18.3.1 → 18.3.1
